findings.pass_through: sle_fw_v1 bus l9_wi (514 bit, E face y 23-112) feeds x_st_a_o (N face, 258 bit) and x_st_b_o (E face y~1247, 258 bit) with NO internal station: 1177 and 1897 um direct legs; rows append a station set (+5/+3 regs). sc pass-through (x_sc_i -> sc_eo/sc_wo): plan from_um sits at E face y6 while input bits enter at y1064-1190 -> from_um re-anchored.
findings.sle_ctl_internal: REAL placed nets, not density: u_ctl (345x259) and u_tap (302x130) are hard macros whose pins sit on the bottom edge (y 328/337, x 189-340 and 646-726; inputs at y~596). Plan anchors are macro centres or off the macro (u_ctl anchor (660,200) lies 137 um below the macro, u_tap anchor (440,400) vs real centre (315,393)). First hop macro pin -> station 1 = 413-581 um. Fix = re-anchor at pins (rows B), no floorplan change.
findings.stm_core_internal: PLACEMENT-DENSITY problem: u_stm_u_stream is a 259x380 reuse core, but its flattened cells spread over ~500x680 (4-5x outline area), so wd_q->lane_c etc run 405-598 um. Fix = soft region guide (rows C) or hard-core floorplan; not a station problem.
findings.cland: u_cland_*/ring hard cores sit at the face (x~17); bins are placed at core centre (x~306): cland->bin 500-540 um, and slw_st_a cland rs_s -> bin 840 um. Plan has no bin site for these (relay_sites only exists on sle_ctl). Proposal: bin sites for sc_wi/ei/rs_* adjacent to cland (needs relay_sites rows in the type); not generated, positions require cland pin data.
findings.su_st: su (vm8q) and st (u_r4.., btab) kits: hard SRAM/ROM macros are scattered across the die (e.g. su twb pins y 333-346, twp y 298-412, vwa y 49-60) while the lpad/pd stations sit at y~1008-1048 -> 800-1222 um. Needs per-macro station chains (macro-anchored rows B cover the conns that exist in the plan; 24 conns not in plan are skipped). Largest, not closed here.
